notes: Manufacturer tech-specs page (https://birddog.tv/mini-overview/mini-techspecs/) confirms: 1x HDMI Standard Type-A input and 1x HDMI Standard Type-A output, both HDMI v1.4a (RGB or YCbCr), supporting up to 1080p60 in encode mode — not 4K, so grade is hdmi-1.4 not a higher tier. Network is 10/100/1000 RJ-45 with PoE 802.3af/at (graded eth-1g as the port's max supported speed; PoE also serves as an alternate power source, noted on the Network port rather than duplicated as a separate power port). Audio is 3.5mm "Microphone headset input/output" — described by BirdDog as a single jack serving both mic-in and headset-out (per BirdDog Comms intercom use), so modeled as one bidirectional TRS-3.5 combo port; no grade applies since it's analog audio. Power: BirdDog lists "100-240V, 50/60Hz Universal Input, +5-18V DC, 7W Max" — this describes an external AC-to-DC power adapter; the physical inlet on the Mini itself is the DC barrel input, modeled as dc-barrel (exact barrel pin diameter, e.g. 5.5x2.1mm, not stated by BirdDog and could not be confirmed from secondary sources). No USB port is documented on the unit. A conflicting secondary source (manua.ls scrape of the user manual) mentioned "SDI inputs and outputs," but this appears to be a scraping error confusing the Mini with BirdDog's separate 4K SDI product line — the official spec page and B&H listing both confirm HDMI-only I/O, so SDI was omitted.
